production_path_policy: OpenBao paths reference secret classes only. Values remain exclusively inside OpenBao and are never copied into source, manifests, logs, tests, chat, or inventory artifacts.

secret_classes.revocation_action: disable or replace the runtime database role and restart only the intended workload
secret_classes.recovery_reference: database recovery runbook and least-privilege role recreation
secret_classes.audit_requirement: record path, operator, reason, correlation ID, and result; never record the value
secret_classes.availability_rule: future fresh retrieval fails closed; a separately approved bounded cached credential policy may govern an already-valid in-memory credential

secret_classes.revocation_action: replace the scoped object-store credential and restart only the intended workload
secret_classes.recovery_reference: evidence-storage recovery runbook and bucket access verification
secret_classes.audit_requirement: record path, operator, reason, correlation ID, and result; never record the value
secret_classes.availability_rule: future fresh retrieval fails closed; evidence workflow behavior must follow an explicit approved outage policy

secret_classes.recovery_reference: signed-transaction canonical vector and controlled sync recovery procedure
secret_classes.audit_requirement: record path, change window, approver, correlation ID, and result; never record the value
secret_classes.availability_rule: fresh secret retrieval fails closed; no unaudited fallback to local environment files in a shared or production deployment

secret_classes.availability_rule: Keycloak may not use INTEGIN application credentials or recovery material

production_preconditions: TLS is required before any shared or production client connection.
No single person, CI process, application process, or one local file may satisfy production recovery separation of duties.
Recovery holders, secure handoff, backup cadence, restore environment, and audit retention require named operator approval.
Application policies must be distinct by workload and path; a workload cannot read another workload's class.
OpenBao audit output must redact values, tokens, unseal shares, private keys, and evidence bytes.
recovery_sequence: Preserve affected volumes and collect status-only evidence.
Restore only into an isolated operator-controlled environment.
Verify configuration, policy inventory, audit device, and path access boundaries without exposing values.
Use dual-control recovery shares according to the approved custody procedure.
Exercise a least-privilege non-production fixture path and record only pass/fail evidence.
Rotate any credential class exposed by the incident before a controlled workload restart.
openbao_recovery_design.non_blocking_rule: Current INTEGIN is intentionally not wired to OpenBao. Future fresh secret issuance or retrieval must fail closed; it must never silently fall back to local shared/production environment files. Existing accepted field transactions must not be blocked solely by a nonessential refresh call.
